scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),c=require('crypto');if(fs.existsSync('.env')){console.log('.env already exists, nothing changed');process.exit(0)}const env=fs.readFileSync('.env.example','utf8').replace(/^ADMIN_PASSWORD=.*$/m,'ADMIN_PASSWORD='+c.randomBytes(18).toString('hex')).replace(/^JWT_SECRET=.*$/m,'JWT_SECRET='+c.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'));fs.writeFileSync('.env',env);console.log('.env created, admin password is in .env')"
scripts.db:reset: node -e "for(const f of ['kindergarten.db','kindergarten.db-wal','kindergarten.db-shm'])require('fs').rmSync(f,{force:true});console.log('Database removed, it will be recreated on next start')"
